name: Rage Scar Hold
summary: At Rage Scar Hold, savage yetis guard their cavern in Feralas, not far from Feathermoon Stronghold. Deeper inside, books, symbols, and night elven stonework point to an older purpose.

sections.title: A Beastly Domain
sections.body: Savage yetis attack anyone who comes near Rage Scar Hold. Alliance sentinels and travelers face danger on the forest trails because of them. Yetis roam Kalimdor’s wild reaches, but these beasts are especially aggressive. They fiercely defend their lair.

sections.title: Traces of the Past
sections.body: Deeper in the cave, carved stonework and night elven architecture mark an older presence. Forgotten tomes and mystic symbols lie among dirt and bone. Did the yetis kill scholars here, or does lingering magic draw the beasts?

faq.answer: Rage Scar Hold is a cave network in Feralas on the mainland, not far from Feathermoon Stronghold. Feral yetis now overrun its halls.

faq.q: Why are there books and symbols inside a yeti den?
faq.answer: Abandoned tomes, scrolls, and arcane symbols remain inside the hold. They suggest spellcasters or night elf scholars once lived there and fell victim to the yetis.

faq.q: Was this cavern built by night elves?
aliases: was rage scar hold an elf barrow
faq.answer: Night elven stonework and structures like those of a barrow den fill the cavern. No living kaldorei remain inside, so its first occupants either left long ago or died when the yetis moved in.

faq.q: Are the yetis here different from others in Kalimdor?
faq.answer: Travelers regard the yetis of Rage Scar Hold as among the fiercest in Feralas. They defend their stolen underground home with feral brutality.

angles.text: As a night elf, seeing filthy yetis defile what seems to be an ancient barrow den or sanctuary is a bitter reminder of wild perils reclaiming kaldorei lands.
As a mage, arcane symbols and abandoned tomes in a beast’s den raise troubling questions about who died in the cavern’s depths.
